articles.summary: Teleport checkout, the Superwall Framework open to every app with CLI and MCP 2.0, the Customer Center on iOS, Android, and Expo, the Google Ads MMP and Android install matching, the new dashboard as default with chart annotations, pinned charts, and Webhooks V2, plus Refund Protection for Google Play.
